name: Clinical-Prior Variational PoE Network on Site-Cancelled Tile Residuals

plan.name: Clinical-Prior Variational PoE Network on Site-Cancelled Tile Residuals
plan.summary: Each patient's clinical profile defines a learned latent prior over PAM50 biology, which is updated via Bayesian Product-of-Experts using pure-histology foundation tile bags decomposed into global morphology and site-cancelled within-patient tile residuals. Precision-weighted gating relies on H&E hotspots mainly when clinical receptors are missing, equivocal, or ambiguous between Luminal A and B, while unlabelled patients align the cross-modal space inside each training fold. Paired repeated nested cross-validation against a tuned clinical-only baseline determines whether H&E morphology improves, worsens, or provides insufficient evidence for cohort PAM50 prediction.
preprocessing: Pool all slides and up to 128 tiles per slide into one patient-level bag using patient_id; keep every patient strictly on one side of every outer, inner, and site split, excluding all RNA-derived variables and excluding site as a predictor.

Inside each training fold (identically across floor_clinical, simple_reference, and multimodal arms), standardize age with training-fold mean/SD and one-hot encode stage, histological_type, er, pr, and her2 with an explicit missing_or_indeterminate level.

Inside each training fold (using fold-training labelled plus allowed unlabelled patients, and excluding held-out-site unlabelled patients during 19-site LOSO sensitivity), L2-normalize tile vectors for UNI2-h, Virchow2, and H-Optimus-1 and fit per-encoder 64-dim whitened PCA, concatenating into 192-dim aligned tile embeddings.

Decompose each patient's 192-dim tile bag into a global mean vector plus site-cancelled within-patient centered tile residuals (tile minus patient mean) and per-dimension residual SD and 90th-10th interdecile range to remove additive slide/site staining shifts.

training.convergence_check: Log per-epoch total, supervised, and KL losses per fold; verify trailing 10-epoch loss change is below 1% of total fold loss reduction before reading predictions (A6).

validation.tie_rule: If grid candidates fall within 1 inner-fold standard error, choose the stronger bottleneck setting (higher beta_kl, smaller latent_dim) per K1.
validation.simplicity_gate_A5: Evaluate fold-matched simple_reference (patient_mean_logreg) on identical inner folds; adopt clinical_prior_poe_vib in an outer fold only when its mean inner-fold macro-F1 strictly exceeds simple_reference, while logging ungated complex OOF curves alongside gated OOF predictions.

metrics: Paired out-of-fold four-class PAM50 macro-F1 difference (image-plus-clinical minus floor_clinical) across 5x3 repeated nested CV with 10,000-resample patient-cluster 95% bootstrap CI
Paired out-of-fold multiclass log-loss difference (image-plus-clinical minus floor_clinical)
Paired out-of-fold macro one-vs-rest AUROC difference (image-plus-clinical minus floor_clinical)
Per-class out-of-fold recall differences for LumA, LumB, Basal, and minority Her2
Paired out-of-fold macro-F1 difference against simple_reference on identical folds
Site-held-out paired macro-F1 difference (image-plus-clinical minus floor_clinical) across 19 collection sites
Per-fold loss/KL convergence diagnostics and mean PoE visual gate weight stratified by definite versus indeterminate/missing HER2
plan.allowed_conclusions: Select strictly one option from the patient-level 95% bootstrap CI for paired OOF macro-F1 difference versus floor_clinical: 'improves' if lower bound > 0; 'insufficient evidence' if 0 lies inside the CI; 'worse' if upper bound < 0. Scope applies only to incremental PAM50 prediction in this TCGA-BRCA cohort, contextualised by 19-site held-out sensitivity, without claiming standalone H&E accuracy, biological causation, or external generalisability.

diversity.data: clinical + pure-histology trio global-plus-within-patient residual tile bags (train+unlabelled)
diversity.model: clinical-prior variational information bottleneck with Bayesian Product-of-Experts precision gating
diversity.method: semi-supervised clinical-prior variational Bayes with patient-specific precision gating and KL incremental-information bottleneck

plan.rationale: Clinical receptors already identify Basal tumours well but leave 31.8% indeterminate HER2 cases and ER+/HER2- Luminal A/B proliferation unresolved. Precision-weighted Product-of-Experts opens the visual gate selectively when clinical uncertainty is high, while within-patient tile residuals and KL regularisation suppress site staining signatures and high-dimensional overfitting.

new_components.name: clinical_prior_poe_vib
new_components.description: Computes: A semi-supervised Clinical-Prior Variational Information Bottleneck with analytical Bayesian Product-of-Experts (PoE) precision gating. A clinical MLP maps fold-encoded clinical covariates c to a diagonal Gaussian prior N(mu_c, sigma_c^2). A visual branch applies gated attention over within-patient centered tile residuals concatenated with global bag mean and residual dispersion (SD, interdecile range) to output visual Gaussian parameters (mu_x, sigma_x^2) with clamped log-variance [-3.0, 1.4] and high-variance initialization so initial visual precision Lambda_x is near zero. Closed-form PoE sets Lambda_cx = Lambda_c + Lambda_x and mu_cx = mu_c + (Lambda_x / Lambda_cx) * (mu_x - mu_c), updating clinical representations selectively on uncertain dimensions. Inputs: Fold-encoded clinical matrix, 192-dim global mean, 384-dim residual dispersion stats, and 192-dim within-patient residual tile bags for labelled fold-train and 259 unlabelled patients. Outputs: Four-class PAM50 probabilities from deterministic MAP latent mu_cx (3-seed outer ensemble), per-patient incremental KL divergence, and epoch loss traces. Training: AdamW on balanced PAM50 cross-entropy from reparameterized z_cx plus clinical_prior_sup_weight balanced PAM50 loss on z_c (labelled train), beta_kl closed-form KL(q(z|c,x) || p(z|c)) with 20-epoch linear warmup, and aux_clinical_weight masked clinical-attribute reconstruction from mu_x across fold-train and unlabelled patients.

plan.name: Decoupled Coarse-to-Fine Five-Encoder Tile-MIL Hierarchy
plan.summary: Each patient's slides form a five-encoder tile bag compressed inside each training fold alongside fold-encoded clinical covariates. A decoupled two-stage hierarchical classifier first fuses clinical and gated multi-encoder tile streams to separate Luminal, Basal, and Her2 lineages, then applies a dedicated tile-attention specialist to distinguish LumA from LumB tumours. Performance is benchmarked against tuned clinical-only and logistic patient-mean models under 5x3 patient-level nested cross-validation and 19-site held-out validation. The patient-level 95% bootstrap interval for paired macro-F1 difference determines incremental H&E value.
preprocessing: Assert exclusion of RNA-derived variables and collection-site predictors across all feature matrices (A1), and pool all slides of multi-slide patients into one patient-level tile bag (A2).

Inside each outer and inner training fold, impute age by training-fold median with z-score scaling and one-hot encode stage, histological_type, er, pr, and her2 with explicit missing and equivocal levels applied identically to clinical_only, simple_reference, and hierarchical arms (A3).
Apply per-tile per-encoder L2 spherical normalisation to attenuate global staining-intensity shifts without accessing collection site.

Fit per-encoder 32-dimensional PCA strictly on labelled training-fold tiles weighted inversely by patient bag size (so multi-slide 471-tile patients do not dominate 6-tile patients), followed by training-fold variance standardisation applied to aligned 5-encoder validation tiles.
Verify baseline integrity (K8) and exact probability simplex normalisation (sum to 1.0 across LumA, LumB, Basal, Her2 via law of total probability) before computing fold metrics.

training.convergence_rule: Log Stage-1 coarse (Luminal/Basal/Her2) and Stage-2 fine (LumA/LumB) train and validation loss curves per fold; require trailing 5-epoch mean loss update below 2% of total fold loss reduction before scoring (A6, K3).

validation.tie_rule: 1-SE parsimony rule across inner folds: select fine_inputs='image' and smaller embed_dim when within one standard error of peak inner macro-F1 (K1).
validation.simplicity_gate: Adopt the hierarchical configuration in an outer fold only when its pooled inner-fold macro-F1 strictly exceeds the fold-matched simple_reference (patient_mean_logreg) inner-fold macro-F1; otherwise fall back to simple_reference for that fold (A5).
validation.site_sensitivity: Companion 19-site leave-one-site-out patient-disjoint cross-validation comparing floor_clinical and hierarchical arms using site strictly for split grouping, never as a feature.

metrics: Paired out-of-fold four-class macro-F1 difference (hierarchical minus floor_clinical) across 5x3 repeated nested CV with 10,000-resample patient-level 95% bootstrap CI (primary)
Paired out-of-fold multiclass log-loss difference (hierarchical minus floor_clinical) with patient-level 95% bootstrap CI
Paired out-of-fold macro one-vs-rest AUROC difference (hierarchical minus floor_clinical) with patient-level 95% bootstrap CI
Per-class out-of-fold recall changes for LumA, LumB, Basal, and minority Her2
Paired out-of-fold macro-F1 difference against simple_reference (patient_mean_logreg) on identical folds
19-site leave-one-site-out paired macro-F1 difference (hierarchical minus floor_clinical) site-confounding sensitivity estimate
plan.allowed_conclusions: Map strictly from the patient-level 95% bootstrap CI of paired out-of-fold macro-F1 difference (verified converged per A6 and gated per A5): conclude 'improves' if lower bound > 0, 'insufficient evidence' if interval spans 0, or 'worse' if upper bound < 0. Inference is restricted to incremental PAM50 prediction over the six clinical covariates in this TCGA-BRCA cohort, qualified by the 19-site sensitivity delta, without claiming standalone image utility, biological causality, or external clinical generalisability.

diversity.data: clinical + all-five aligned foundation-model tile bags with L2-normalised patient-balanced fold-PCA
diversity.model: decoupled two-stage coarse-to-fine hierarchical classifier with gated five-encoder tile-attention MIL specialists
diversity.method: law-of-total-probability coarse-lineage late-average anchoring + dedicated intra-Luminal tile MIL under 2-fold 1-SE nested CV

plan.rationale: Clinical receptors separate Basal well but falter on LumA-versus-LumB proliferation and missing-HER2 minority cases (D1, D2, D5, D7). Decoupling late-fused coarse lineage routing from a dedicated Luminal five-encoder tile-attention specialist focuses morphological capacity on focal proliferative hotspots while curbing overfitting (D3, D6).
